details: Focused clean polish of the single Pearl Rose mobile theme (existing CSS replaced in place, not layered): corrected harsh photo seams on hero/catalog/PDF cards and restored legible card text, compact fixed bottom dock, optimized card vertical spacing and brighter white surfaces. 14 distinct shaded vector illustrations for TTK, PDF, drink, packaging and settings; four catalog photography cards retain their real existing images, while seven unavailable features remain marked SOON. 5 routes and cloud/status/refresh logic preserved. No database, A4/TTK editor, native APK or cloud data modified. Desktop workspace theme unchanged. No pixel-perfect 8K or real-device speed claim.
